name: Sinhagad

trails.name: Main footpath
trails.note: Most popular route. Steep in places with loose stones; very crowded on weekend mornings. Joins the top near Pune Darwaja.

water: Dev Take, a rock-cut cistern near the top, is the traditional water source; treat or filter before drinking.
Stalls at the top sell bottled water on most days, but carry at least 2 litres for the climb.

landmarks.name: Pune Darwaja
landmarks.note: The gate facing Pune; the main footpath and the road arrive near here.

landmarks.name: Kalyan Darwaja
landmarks.note: Gate on the far (south-west) side of the fort, above Kalyan village.

landmarks.name: Tanaji Malusare memorial
landmarks.note: Memorial to Tanaji Malusare, who died capturing the fort in 1670.

landmarks.name: Samadhi of Chhatrapati Rajaram
landmarks.note: Rajaram Maharaj died at Sinhagad in 1700; his samadhi is on the fort.

landmarks.name: Dev Take
landmarks.note: Old water cistern near the top.

landmarks.name: Food stalls
landmarks.note: Known for pithla-bhakri, kanda bhaji and matka dahi.

safety: The footpath gets slippery in rain; wear shoes with grip, not sandals.
Monkeys snatch food bags — keep food zipped away.
Start descending well before sunset; the path has no lighting.
Forest department may restrict access on some days — check before leaving.

returnTransport.note: PMPML buses run between Swargate and the Sinhagad base area; confirm the route number and last bus time locally.

en: Sinhagad was earlier known as Kondhana.
In 1670 Tanaji Malusare led a night assault up the cliffs and won the fort for Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj, but was killed in the fight.
Popular tradition says Shivaji Maharaj grieved, 'Gad aala pan simha gela' — the fort is won, but the lion is lost.
Chhatrapati Rajaram Maharaj died at Sinhagad in 1700; his samadhi is on the fort.
Lokmanya Tilak had a bungalow on Sinhagad.
mr: १६७० मध्ये तानाजी मालुसरे यांनी रात्रीच्या वेळी कडा चढून हा गड जिंकला, पण या लढाईत त्यांना वीरमरण आले.
"गड आला पण सिंह गेला" असे छत्रपती शिवाजी महाराज म्हणाले, अशी लोकप्रिय कथा आहे.
छत्रपती राजाराम महाराजांची समाधी सिंहगडावर आहे.
